attr.title: New Pal
attr.desc: A port of the iOS version of 新仙剑奇侠传 (The Legend of Sword and Fairy / NewPAL), a classic Chinese RPG by Softstar.
attr.desc_md: A port of the iOS version of **新仙剑奇侠传** (*The Legend of Sword and Fairy* / *NewPAL*), a classic Chinese RPG by Softstar.
attr.inst:
- Install the port via PortMaster.
- Legally obtain the iOS version of 新仙剑奇侠传 as an .ipa file. No game data is included in this port.
- Copy the .ipa file into the newpal/ port folder.
- Launch the port; the first run extracts the game automatically (about 1.7 GB, a few minutes). The .ipa is removed after successful verification.
- Requires an aarch64 device with glibc. Tested on TrimUI Brick (NX-Redux).
attr.inst_md:
- Install the port via PortMaster.
- Legally obtain the iOS version of 新仙剑奇侠传 (NewPAL) as an `.ipa` file. **No game data is included in this port.**
- Copy the `.ipa` into the `newpal/` port folder (the folder is also printed in the on-screen message when data is missing).
- Launch the port: the first run shows an on-screen extraction progress bar, then automatically verifies and removes the `.ipa`.
- Requires an aarch64 device with glibc; audio uses the system ALSA dmix. Tested on TrimUI Brick / NX-Redux.
